Knowledge of infrastructure architecture, modernization, migrations, relocations, decommissioning, capacity planning, and technology lifecycle management. Strong understanding of identity and access management, privileged access, multifactor authentication, single sign-on, service accounts, non-human identities, and emergency access controls. Knowledge of infrastructure security practices, including patching, vulnerability remediation, certificate lifecycle management, secure configuration standards, and system hardening. Working knowledge of business continuity, disaster recovery, backup, audit, compliance, and operational risk management requirements. Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop technical teams while establishing clear standards, processes, documentation, and accountability. Strong incident management, troubleshooting, escalation, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action skills for complex and recurring infrastructure issues. Ability to plan, prioritize, and execute infrastructure projects and operational initiatives while balancing reliability, security, cost, and business needs. Ability to analyze service performance, capacity, lifecycle, and operational data to identify risk, recommend improvements, and support informed decisions. Manage the full lifecycle of telecommunications and network circuits. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks, priorities, and recommendations to business and technology stakeholders. Professional attitude, team player, good interpersonal communication skills and able to work across company departments.
